home.architectureDesc: Even if the UI is bypassed, business rules are still enforced by BFFs at the data access layer. Approval status is driven and written back by platform Flow.
home.architectureTitle: Guardrails at the Data Layer, Flow at the Platform Layer
home.boundary.dal: Tables and Custom SQL are resolved by the platform DAL via physical table names and unique resource names; business code no longer maintains resource UUID mappings.
home.boundary.flow: All approval documents are initiated, routed, and written back by the native platform Flow; no custom approval state machine is maintained.
home.boundary.policy: Row-level read and write control is enforced by Instant API Policy routing, deny rules, and platform roles.
home.boundaryDesc: This project demonstrates only the currently recommended standard implementation, with the following explicit engineering boundaries.

legalAgreement.document.clause1.para1: Confidential information under this Agreement refers to non-public information disclosed, provided, or made known by one Party to the other through oral, written, electronic, system interface, account authorization, on-site access, or any other means. The Parties are both disclosing and receiving parties: the Party disclosing information is the Disclosing Party, and the Party receiving, obtaining, or becoming aware of the information is the Receiving Party.
legalAgreement.document.clause1.para2: Confidential information includes, without limitation: Party A's or its customers' data, business data, account permissions, project materials, customer information, operating data, financial information, contract texts, commercial terms, meeting minutes, requirement documents, processes and policies, system configurations, interface documents, access credentials, keys, personal information, and important data; as well as Party B's product proposals, source code, algorithms, models, prompts, technical architecture, pricing strategies, delivery methods, intellectual property, and other non-public information required to be protected by law or agreement.
legalAgreement.document.clause1.title: Article 1 Confidential Information
legalAgreement.document.clause10.para1: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China. Any dispute arising from or in connection with this Agreement shall first be resolved through friendly negotiation; failing that, it shall be submitted to the {org} for resolution by {method}.
legalAgreement.document.clause10.title: Article 10 Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
legalAgreement.document.clause11.para1: This Agreement is independent of any business contract separately signed by the Parties for specific projects, orders, trials, procurements, or services. If a business contract imposes higher requirements on confidentiality, data security, personal information protection, or intellectual property protection, that contract prevails; where there is no such agreement or the agreement is unclear, this Agreement applies.
legalAgreement.document.clause11.title: Article 11 Miscellaneous
legalAgreement.document.clause2.para1: The Receiving Party may use confidential information only for {cooperationMatter} and the cooperation purposes set out in this Agreement, within the necessary, minimal, and authorized scope. Without the Disclosing Party's prior written consent, the Receiving Party shall not use the confidential information for R&D, training, sales, competitive analysis, external display, commercial promotion, or any other purpose beyond the purposes of this Agreement.
legalAgreement.document.clause2.title: Article 2 Purpose of Cooperation and Scope of Use
legalAgreement.document.clause3.para1: The Receiving Party shall protect the Disclosing Party's confidential information with no less care than it protects its own similar important information, and shall take reasonable administrative, technical, and access-control measures. Without the Disclosing Party's prior written consent, the Receiving Party shall not disclose, provide, publish, transfer, sell, upload, post, copy, reverse engineer, or otherwise dispose of the confidential information to any third party.
legalAgreement.document.clause3.para2: Where the Receiving Party needs to disclose confidential information to its employees, consultants, contractors, or affiliates for cooperation purposes, it shall limit disclosure to those who need to know and ensure such persons bear confidentiality obligations no lower than those in this Agreement. The Receiving Party shall be liable for the acts of such persons.
legalAgreement.document.clause3.title: Article 3 Confidentiality Obligations of Both Parties
legalAgreement.document.clause4.para1: When Party B accesses or processes Party A's confidential information, Party A's or its customers' data, business data, account permissions, system environments, interface credentials, test data, production data, or personal information, it shall use them solely for the project purposes authorized by Party A, and shall not access, copy, retain, download, transfer, analyze, or provide them to third parties beyond that scope.
legalAgreement.document.clause4.para2: Without Party A's prior written consent, Party B shall not use Party A's confidential information for model training, sample accumulation, case publicity, product demos, external bidding, customer list display, or any other purpose unrelated to the project authorized by Party A. Party B shall, upon Party A's reasonable request, cooperate in permission revocation, data deletion, material return, access-log review, and security incident handling.
legalAgreement.document.clause4.title: Article 4 Special Obligations of Party B
legalAgreement.document.clause5.para1: The following are not confidential information: information the Receiving Party can prove it lawfully knew before disclosure; information that entered the public domain other than through the Receiving Party's breach; information lawfully obtained by the Receiving Party from a third party entitled to disclose it; and information independently developed by the Receiving Party without using the Disclosing Party's confidential information. Where the Receiving Party is required by laws, regulations, regulators, judicial authorities, or securities trading rules to disclose, it shall notify the Disclosing Party in advance to the extent permitted by law and make reasonable efforts to help the Disclosing Party take protective measures.
legalAgreement.document.clause5.title: Article 5 Exclusions
legalAgreement.document.clause6.para1: Upon termination of the cooperation, cessation of negotiations between the Parties, or a written request by the Disclosing Party, the Receiving Party shall, within {days} business days and as required by the Disclosing Party, return, delete, or destroy all confidential information in its possession, together with copies, backups, excerpts, and derivative materials.
legalAgreement.document.clause6.title: Article 6 Return and Destruction
legalAgreement.document.clause7.para1: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, the confidentiality period runs from the effective date of this Agreement until the termination of the cooperation matter, cessation of negotiations between the Parties, or the rescission or termination of the relevant contract, plus {years} years. For trade secrets, technical secrets, unpublished source code, account keys, personal information, and important data, the confidentiality obligations remain in force as long as they remain confidential in nature.
legalAgreement.document.clause7.title: Article 7 Confidentiality Period
legalAgreement.document.clause8.para1: Disclosure, receipt, or use of confidential information does not transfer any ownership, intellectual property, data rights, license rights, or other rights. Party A's and its customers' data, business data, project materials, and account permissions belong to Party A or its lawful right holders; Party B's products, platforms, code, models, algorithms, technical solutions, delivery tools, and methodology belong to Party B or its lawful right holders. Any separate written agreement prevails.
legalAgreement.document.clause8.title: Article 8 Ownership and Intellectual Property
legalAgreement.document.clause9.title: Article 9 Liability for Breach
legalAgreement.document.extraNote.title: Other Notes
legalAgreement.document.penalty.actualLo: In case of breach by either Party, the breaching Party shall immediately cease the breach, take remedial measures, eliminate the impact, and compensate the non-breaching Party for all losses and reasonable enforcement costs incurred.
legalAgreement.document.penalty.fixedAmo: In case of breach by either Party, the breaching Party shall compensate the non-breaching Party for all losses and pay a penalty of CNY {amount}.
legalAgreement.document.penalty.none: In case of breach by either Party, the breaching Party shall immediately cease the breach and compensate the non-breaching Party for all losses and reasonable enforcement costs incurred.
legalAgreement.document.penalty.percentO: In case of breach by either Party, the breaching Party shall compensate the non-breaching Party for all losses and pay a penalty of {percent}% of the deal amount the Parties intend to reach or have reached.
legalAgreement.document.preamble.effecti: This Agreement is signed in {signingPlace} on {agreementDate} and takes effect on the date of signature or seal by both Parties.
legalAgreement.document.preamble.recital: Whereas: Party A intends to carry out {cooperationMatter} with Party B regarding {projectName}. As a provider of services, product trials, technical integration, or contract performance, Party B may access, obtain, or process non-public information of Party A or its customers, such as business data, account permissions, project materials, commercial arrangements, and technical materials. The Parties may also mutually disclose non-public information of commercial, technical, operational, or compliance value. To protect their lawful rights and interests, the Parties, on the principles of equality, voluntariness, fairness, and good faith, sign this Agreement and jointly abide by it.
